features.note: Display CONTENT delivered with strict discipline. On-state shows PANDUIT (sourced manufacturer) plus three labeled rows INPUT / OUTPUT / BATTERY with UNSCALED bars. Verified by me: NOT ONE number or unit anywhere on the screen — no voltage, no load %, no runtime. The labels name the magnitudes a UPS monitors (definitional — a box that did not track input/output/battery would not be a UPS), marked [INFER] since the exact on-screen text is unpublished; same discipline as the PDU display showing structure without fabricated values. Wired to power as an EMISSIVE map (never base-color, which would light the panel with the unit OFF): the ?power=off capture confirms the screen goes fully DARK, so an on unit with a dark screen — the exact lie the first blockout failed on — cannot recur. __qaState now reports lcdEmissiveIntensity. Variant respected (3.5in touch for the 5-10 kVA range, not the 2.8in segmented LCD of 1-3 kVA units).
Button + LED column read; LEDs green on, dark off, consistent with the display. No regression.

The front grille now READS on its own: a bright stamped LIP under each slot (a pressed grille has a folded sheet edge that catches light and draws a hard bright line). Measured in reflected environment: lip 0.3365 vs throat 0.0010 = 329x separation (vs 12.1x for blade-vs-throat), which is what lets the front grille carry ventilation from the hero without leaning on the side vents. The side-vent grid also reads strongly on the deep flank.

important_features.note: No regression; side vents reinforce depth.

defects: OPEN ITEM (not a defect): rear receptacle layout still unbuilt (no P1 source).
Display is honestly minimal (labels + bars, no values) — correct, not a defect.
corrections: Keep rear receptacles as an OPEN ITEM.

mechanical.notes: Console clean (0/0) on default and power=off, pure offline. ORCHESTRATOR VERIFICATION of the text-risk pass: (1) the on-screen display carries no numeral or unit; the build check fails on any numeral/unit in the screen strings AND on the art being bound as a base-color (rather than emissive) map. (2) I checked the SOURCE for any side-flank text/wordmark/canvas after the deep flank read letter-like in the capture — grep of ups-panduit.mjs for panduit/wordmark/fillText/canvasTexture/logo found NONE; the flank pattern is the side_vents geometry (slots + bright lips) at a grazing angle, not text (identical in on/off confirms it is not emissive branding). No unsourced text anywhere. Budget unchanged 42/250, 1144/400000. verifyNoCoincidentPlanes caught the builder's first lip placement (front face exactly on the bezel plane, 448 mm2) and it was sunk 0.4 mm in — the third time this guard corrected the builder rather than the inherited model.

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment. The hard part of this pass — the display content — was solved honestly: a UPS screen shows live measurements, so any drawn figure would be a fabricated reading at the same fidelity as the sourced geometry around it; the builder drew PANDUIT + INPUT/OUTPUT/BATTERY labels with unscaled bars and NOT ONE value, lit only when powered (emissive, dark off). I verified the text discipline directly, including checking the source to confirm the letter-like flank pattern is vents, not text. The front grille now reads via a physically-correct stamped lip (329x contrast). Cleared to the lighting-camera pass; rear receptacles carried as an open item.
